subject: RULED s373: BEHIND #153's FOLD — `pipe my ($r, $w)`: a `my (LIST)` in an argument run contributes ONE vector arg, not N args
description:
`pipe my ($r, $w)` emits `(p-pipe (vector $r $w))` — ONE vector arg where p-pipe takes two — so the form fails to compile ("Execution of a form compiled with errors"). RULED s369 §4: fix at ARGUMENT-RUN LOWERING (a `my (LIST)` contributes N args), never per-builtin at the runtime.

SIZED s372 (the ruled size-first step; NOT started):

* POPULATION (both corpora + PCL's lib/): the `WORD my (LIST)` shape in an
  argument run occurs in **one file** — `t/op/getppid.t`, 3 occurrences
  (`pipe my ($r,$w)`, `($r2,$w2)`, `($r3,$w3)`). The other `my (…)`-after-a-word
  hits are prose or `tie my($x)`.
* THE ONE-ELEMENT CASE ALREADY WORKS and is NOT the mechanism to extend:
  `tie my ($x), 'T'` → `(p-tie $x "T")` and `f my ($c)` → `(pl-f $c)` — that is
  the generic single-element-paren unwrap, not decl-list handling. So there is
  no existing "splice N" path to route through; the fix ADDS one.
* USER SUBS ARE UNAFFECTED: `f my ($a,$b)` emits `(pl-f (vector $a $b))` and
  prints `args=2`, because p-sub flattens its argument vector into @_. The bug
  bites only a BUILTIN with fixed arity, where the vector is one argument.
* SHAPE OF THE FIX: in the argument-run builder, a `PPI::Structure::List` tagged
  `_pcl_decl_list` (PExpr.pm:308/380, carried through Parser2's
  @PPI_ADHOC_KEYS) contributes its DEPTH-0 elements as separate args — split
  with the shared #138/#140 splitter (`TokenUtils::lowprec_idx`), never a new
  comma scan.
* RISK / why it is not a 20-line filler: PExpr has SEVERAL argument-run paths
  (known-builtin arity path, bare list-operator pass, user-sub call), and
  `_pcl_decl_list` is consulted today only to REJECT the list as the call's own
  parens (PExpr.pm:3260). CLAUDE.md §11 says count the parse paths and push the
  fix to the one place they all pass through — that place has to be found first,
  and it is inside the operand/term region `docs/pexpr-term-parsing-review.md`
  warns about. Size honestly: half a session, with the getppid.t rows as the
  bar and the gate SET over both populations (1 file can change).
